description.zh: 查询范围的起始时间戳。单位：毫秒。
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. Unit: milliseconds.

description.zh:
查询类型取值有两种

- byOffset：通过位点来进行查询。选择位点查询则需要填入分区ID和分区位点参数。

- byTimestamp：通过时间来进行查询。选择时间查询则需要填入BeginTime参数。
description.en:
The query type. Valid values:

- byOffset: queries messages by offset. If you select this type, you must specify the Partition and Offset parameters.

- byTimestamp: queries messages by time. If you select this type, you must specify the BeginTime parameter.
The region ID of the resource.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun alikafka query-message --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id alikafka_pre-cn-mp919o4v0000 --topic testkafka --query-type byTimestamp --partition 0 --offset 100 --begin-time 1672410180000 --api-version 2019-09-16 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun alikafka QueryMessage --region cn-hangzhou --Partition 0 --InstanceId 'alikafka_pre-cn-mp919o4v0000' --BeginTime 1672410180000 --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --Topic testkafka --QueryType byTimestamp --Offset 100
